data.label: Law Enforcement Governed Record
data.description: A law enforcement record. The governed record: the data cluster, the PROV activity and agent and the audit event from the ProvGov library by identifier, and the digital signature proof. Members: Incident Report; prov-activity (Provgov); prov-agent (Provgov); audit-event (Provgov); Digital Signature Proof.

items.label: Digital Signature Proof
items.description: Cryptographic proof of attestation (digital signature)

items.label: Audit Event
items.description: A logged access or custody event as data: what was done, by whom, on what, with what outcome and for what purpose. The audit-only case of sdc5 issue 002; state-changing operations are workflow transitions.

items.label: Audit Agent Reference
items.description: The acting agent (FHIR AuditEvent.agent.who). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Audit Entity Reference
items.description: The entity the event concerns (FHIR AuditEvent.entity.what). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Audit Event Identifier
items.description: The identifier of the audit event.

items.label: Data Subject Reference
items.description: The data subject or patient the event concerns (FHIR AuditEvent.patient; SDC DM.subject). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: On Behalf Of Reference
items.description: The party on whose behalf the agent acted (FHIR agent.onBehalfOf; prov:actedOnBehalfOf). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: System Identifier
items.description: The system that handled the item (FHIR AuditEvent.source.observer; SDC AuditType.system-id).

items.label: System Location Name
items.description: The site or facility that handled the item (FHIR AuditEvent.agent.location; prov:atLocation).

items.label: Audit Event Action
items.description: The operation performed in a logged access event (FHIR AuditEvent.action). Read and Execute change no state and are audit facts, not workflow moves.

items.label: Audit Event Outcome
items.description: The result of an audited event (FHIR AuditEvent.outcome).

items.label: Confidentiality
items.description: The level of protection the information requires (HL7 v3 Confidentiality). At assembly the value populates a component's act tag.

items.label: Provenance Agent Type
items.description: The functional role of an agent in an activity (FHIR Provenance.agent.type).

items.label: Purpose of Use
items.description: Why the information was used (HL7 v3 ActReason purpose of use). Activity context, not an access-control tag.

items.label: Audit Recorded At
items.description: When the audit event was recorded (FHIR AuditEvent.recorded).

items.label: Incident Report
items.description: A law enforcement incident: the subject's national ID, the NIEM incident (identification, date, description, location, category and status codes, the arrest with its charges and subject, evidence, officials), the Cordova incident status, city and province, the Cordova charge details and quarantine enforcement. Members: National ID (CID); j-incident (NIEM); Incident Status; City; Province; Charge Details (Cordova); Quarantine Enforcement.

items.label: National ID (CID)
items.description: Cordova National Identity Number. Format: COR-PPCC-NNNNNN where PP is the two-letter province code (AL=Aldara, BR=Brevina, CE=Celara), CC is the two-digit city code (01-03), and NNNNNN is a six-digit sequence number. Issued at birth or naturalization. Required for all government transactions.

items.label: City
items.description: One of the nine cities in the Republic of Cordova.

items.label: Incident Status
items.description: Current status of the incident

items.label: Province
items.description: One of the three provinces of the Republic of Cordova. Used across civil registry, property, tax, and all geographic records.

items.label: Charge Details (Cordova)
items.description: What the Cordova courts add to a NIEM charge: the fine or bail amount in Córdobas and the disposition date. Members: Fine or Bail Amount; Disposition Date.

items.label: Fine or Bail Amount
items.description: Monetary amount of the fine imposed or bail set for the charge in Cordova Córdoba. Null if no financial penalty applies or bail is denied.

items.label: Disposition Date
items.description:
Date the disposition was recorded
